title: The Orchard Climb
description: Gain real altitude from the orchard floor through terraces, branches and retaining walls to a high overlook.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute day
identity.visual_source: Original generated pixel-art plate with native animated scenery

signs.text:
The orchard floor
Begin among the fallen fruit

The fruit-tree terraces
Rise between the planted terraces

Among the high branches
Reverse around the tree’s upper branches

The retaining walls
Work around the old wall passages

The high orchard overlook
One last climb reveals the valley
